page: Vultr vc2-2c-4gb is a shared-CPU instance belonging to the Cloud Compute family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 4.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of an 80 GB NVMe SSD. Additionally, the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the lower performance tiers. In stress-ng tests, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance register in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 176.23 GB/sec, while large block read-only bandwidth drops to 19.26 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 10%. Geekbench scores reflect similar constraints, with single-core, multi-core, and software compilation metrics all falling within the bottom 10%. Database operations and Redis SET operations, which reached 1.36 million operations per second, also rank in the bottom 10%.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads that do not require sustained high CPU utilization. The presence of local NVMe SSD storage provides fast read and write speeds relative to non-SSD options, though the shared CPU architecture introduces potential resource contention. This server is best suited for low-traffic web serving, basic development environments, lightweight background tasks, and small-scale testing.
